faq.q: Should I come with washed hair?
faq.a: Not for colour and treatments, the shampoo is included. For braids, come washed and detangled the day before.

faq.q: How long does a balayage take?
faq.a: Allow three hours with the treatment and the blow-dry. A ten-minute diagnosis always comes first.

faq.q: Can I book with a specific stylist?
faq.a: Yes, pick your stylist when booking online.
A 20% deposit confirms the appointment and is deducted from the total on the day.
